scope: These figures describe the {n_total} loans of the mature {test_years} test window ({term}-month term, at least 90% resolved), not the full {n_rows} resolved loans.

sheets.title: Observed default
sheets.headline: {default_rate_total}
sheets.headline_label: of resolved loans ended in default
sheets.computation: We divide {observed_defaults} observed defaults by {n_total} resolved loans (Wilson 95% CI {ci_low}-{ci_high}).
sheets.reading: About {defaults_per_100} of every 100 loans ended in default.
sheets.caveat: Only mature loans are measured because later vintages are right-censored.

sheets.title: Predicted PD
sheets.headline: {mean_pd}
sheets.computation: The {champion} model averages {mean_pd} predicted PD over the same loans, with out-of-time AUC {champion_auc}.
sheets.reading: Observed is {gap_pp} pp above predicted, so the model underestimates risk on average.

sheets.title: Expected loss
sheets.headline: {el_pct_ead} of EAD
sheets.headline_label: expected loss on EAD at default
sheets.computation: EL = PD x LGD x EAD; EAD = funded amount x train-grade EAD rate.
sheets.reading: EL is the portfolio's expected credit loss at default under the train-grade EAD rate.
sheets.caveat: EAD at default is estimated on train defaults, not the full funded amount.
